# Plenish

> Plenish is a meal prep inventory and nutrition tracking app that auto-generates weekly meal plans based on the perishability of prepped food. Built for people on GLP-1 medications, people with ADHD managing food decisions, and dedicated meal preppers.

## Marketing Site (useplenish.com)

- [Home](/): Features overview and sign-up

- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about meal planning, nutrition tracking, and using Plenish

- [Blog](/blog): Nutrition, meal prep, and wellness articles

- [Blog: GLP-1 daily nutrition tracking](/blog/glp1-daily-nutrition-tracking-doesnt-work): Article covering nutrition tracking strategies for people on GLP-1 medications

- [Blog: ADHD and food noise](/blog/adhd-food-tracking-noise-different-approach): Article on managing food decisions and reducing food noise for people with ADHD

## App Features (app.useplenish.com — requires account)

The app is a web and mobile application with the following core areas:

- **Inventory**: Track prepped food by item, quantity, desired meal time, and perishability

- **Meal Planning**: Auto-generated weekly meal plans prioritizing items closest to expiring

- **Nutrition Tracking**: Log calories, protein, fiber, carbohydrates, and fat; set weekly goals

- **Meal Log**: Record meals eaten against inventory

- **AI Nutritional Estimator**: Estimates nutritional values for any meal using USDA and brand data; returns a confidence value

- **Account/Settings**: Profile, notification preferences, subscription tier, nutrition goals, and visible planning weeks
